description: This file defines the React component 'Toolbar' which provides a control bar for a Kanban board application. It includes functionalities for exporting/importing cards, managing columns, toggling fullscreen, and undoing CSV sync actions.

methods.name: downloadExcelTemplate()
methods.description: Generates and triggers download of an Excel template for Kanban cards with predefined columns.

methods.name: handleAddColumn
methods.description: Sets state to show modal for adding a new column.

methods.name: handleAddColumnSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission for adding a new column and updates the board.

methods.name: handleExcelUpload
methods.description: Handles uploading of an Excel file, reads its content, and shows modal for column mapping.

methods.name: handleConfirmBulkUpload
methods.description: Processes bulk upload data from Excel, maps to card objects, and inserts them into the board.

methods.name: handleExportCardsCsv
methods.description: Exports current cards on the board to a CSV file for download.

methods.name: handleCsvFileSelected
methods.description: Reads selected CSV file, previews data, and shows confirmation modal.

methods.name: handleConfirmCsvSync
methods.description: Performs CSV sync with undo support, updating the board accordingly.

methods.name: handleUndoCsvSync
methods.description: Undoes the last CSV sync using the latest snapshot.

methods.name: Toolbar({ onToggleFullscreen, isFullscreen, crOnly, onToggleCrOnly, canEdit = true })

ctags.name: Toolbar
ctags.pattern: /^function Toolbar({ onToggleFullscreen, isFullscreen, crOnly, onToggleCrOnly, canEdit = true }) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ onToggleFullscreen, isFullscreen, crOnly, onToggleCrOnly, canEdit = true })
